p: Google's new flagship AI model, released to developers and businesses worldwide.
Google says it excels at complex, multi-step tasks in coding, finance, law, cybersecurity and science.
API pricing starts at US$2 per million input tokens and US$10 per million output tokens. Rates double after November 30.
Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers get it in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search. The Antigravity coding tool is limited to Ultra.
Google says teams using Argon in Antigravity raised agentic code submissions by more than 35 percent.

items: scientists get six months of free Antigravity access
